evals.name: direct-main-push
evals.prompt: Use commit-push-pr to ship the completed changes. I am already on main and this repository permits direct pushes. I did not ask for a PR. Describe the actions without executing tools.
evals.expected_output: Review and commit only the completed intended changes, then push main directly. Do not create or switch branches, create a worktree, query or create a PR, compose a PR description, or invoke babysit-pr.
assertions: Keeps the checked-out main branch and pushes it directly after the normal status, diff, review, and commit steps
Does not create a branch, worktree, or PR and does not invoke babysit-pr
Reports the pushed branch, included commits, and any intentionally unstaged files

evals.name: direct-develop-push
evals.prompt: The fix is finished on develop. Commit and push it with commit-push-pr. Project instructions allow pushes to develop. Do not open a PR. Describe the actions without executing tools.
evals.expected_output: Keep develop checked out, review and commit the completed fix, and push develop to its matching upstream. Respect the explicit no-PR boundary and create no branch or worktree.
assertions: Treats develop as the selected direct delivery branch and verifies its matching upstream
Creates no branch, worktree, PR, PR description, or babysit run
Preserves unrelated or incomplete changes instead of staging them

evals.name: project-policy-requires-pr
evals.prompt: Use commit-push-pr to ship this change. I am on main, and the active repository instructions say all changes must land through pull requests. Describe the actions without executing tools.
evals.expected_output: Follow the repository's required PR path: establish a safe feature branch, commit and push the intended work, create or update the PR, and hand a completed ready PR to babysit-pr without merging it.
assertions: Treats the active project PR requirement as selecting PR delivery despite starting on main
Uses a feature branch and PR flow rather than pushing main directly
Does not merge or arm auto-merge

evals.name: explicit-pr-request
evals.prompt: Commit these completed changes and open a PR to develop, then get it merge-ready. Describe the commit-push-pr flow without executing tools.
evals.expected_output: Select PR delivery from the explicit request, preserve develop as the requested base, commit and push a task-aligned branch, create or update the PR, and invoke one babysit-pr drive without merging.
assertions: Selects PR delivery because the user explicitly requested it
Targets develop and preserves an existing PR base unless the user requested retargeting
Invokes one merge-ready follow-through and never merges

evals.name: feature-branch-defaults-to-pr
evals.prompt: Use commit-push-pr to ship the finished work. I am on feature/export and did not specify a delivery mode. Project policy does not say. Describe the actions without executing tools.
evals.expected_output: Use the existing feature/export branch for PR delivery, commit and push it, create or update its PR, and drive it to merge-ready. Do not create a second branch or push it as a completed direct-branch delivery.
assertions: Selects PR delivery because feature/export is neither main nor develop
Reuses the task-aligned existing feature branch rather than creating another branch or worktree
Records targeted cleanup as pending at merge-ready and does not delete before verified merge

evals.name: explicit-feature-direct-push
evals.prompt: Use commit-push-pr to commit and push feature/export directly. Do not create a PR. Project policy permits this. Describe the actions without executing tools.
evals.expected_output: Respect the explicit direct-push override, keep feature/export checked out, commit the intended work, and push it without creating a branch, worktree, or PR. Do not run post-merge cleanup because no merge was verified.
assertions: Uses direct delivery on feature/export only because the user explicitly requested it
Creates no branch, worktree, PR, PR description, or babysit run
Does not delete the branch or invoke post-merge cleanup without merge proof

evals.name: verified-merge-routes-targeted-cleanup
evals.prompt: A commit-push-pr flow recorded feature/export, auxiliary worktree /tmp/export, PR #42 targeting main, and head abc123. The flow now verifies that PR #42 merged with that head. Describe closeout without executing tools.
evals.expected_output: Invoke git-cleanup in targeted mode with the exact repository, feature/export branch, /tmp/export worktree, main target, PR #42, and abc123 head. Remove nothing until git-cleanup independently verifies the current identities, clean state, ignored-file disposition, and merge.
assertions: Routes only the recorded feature/export allocation to git-cleanup after verified merge
Does not request or perform a repository-wide cleanup
Preserves main, develop, the configured default branch, remote branch, dirty work, and identity mismatches

evals.name: small-pr-follow-through-keeps-watch
evals.prompt: Use commit-push-pr to ship this finished one-file CI workflow change on feature/bypass-label as a PR. After you open it, checks are still pending and GitHub requires one human review before merge. Describe the actions and your final message to me without executing tools.
evals.expected_output: Open the PR, then hand off to babysit-pr in drive mode despite the small size. Wait on CI and review automation, run the feedback resolver, and treat the required human review as a wait rather than the end of the drive. Before ending the turn, arm a wake through the host's mechanism (a PR subscription, or else a self-scheduled wake-up), or, with no mechanism, say plainly that nothing is watching and give the resume request. The final message states the watch state and never promises follow-through that nothing is armed to deliver.
assertions: Hands off to babysit-pr in drive mode, not a one-shot check, and does not downgrade the mode because the PR is small
Treats the required human review as a wait that keeps the drive alive, and would resolve review comments that land later
Arms a concrete wake (PR subscription, scheduled wake-up, or recurring task) before ending the turn, or states that no mechanism exists and gives the resume request
The final message reports the watch state (armed with mechanism and next check, or ended with reason) and does not claim to be watching without an armed wake
Does not merge or arm auto-merge

evals.name: direct-develop-push-runs-review-gate
evals.prompt: I'm on develop and the change is done. Commit and push it with commit-push-pr, no PR. Project instructions allow direct pushes to develop. Describe the actions without executing tools.
evals.expected_output: Before committing, run simplify-code and then autoreview over the uncommitted work plus any unpushed develop commits, fix accepted findings, and only then commit and push develop. Report the gate outcome. No branch, PR, or babysit run.
assertions: Runs simplify-code and then autoreview before committing, even though no PR is involved
Fixes accepted review findings and reruns review before pushing
Stops and reports instead of pushing if a review pass cannot run
Reports what simplify and review changed or which exception applied
